method: Read-only code mapping by four parallel agents (SEC ingestion, Quant, Screener/Discover/CI, Supertrader) plus lead verification of normalize.py; every entry proven by file:function. Branch-only code is marked.

steps.raw: SECProvider.iter_raw_facts: companyfacts per CIK or bulk zip; forms 10-K/10-Q/20-F/40-F and /A only (10-KT, 6-K dropped); availability = acceptanceDateTime from submissions, else filing date
steps.tagSelection: registry priority per (metric, fiscal year, fiscal period, accession) - normalize.py normalize_company; rival concepts in the same filing flagged CONCEPT_DISAGREEMENT; custom (company-extension) namespaces never mapped (counted unmapped)
steps.period: FiscalCalendar learned from annual facts (52/53 weeks), duration buckets Q 75-105, H 160-200, 9M 250-295, FY 330-390 days; PeriodResolver.quarter_grid: Qn = YTDn - YTDn-1, Q4 = FY - YTD3 - applied to EPS as well (per-share not additive)
steps.pit: FactTimeline per cell holds every filing as observation; policies AS_OF_LATEST (default), ORIGINAL, LATEST_KNOWN; derived values take the latest availability of inputs
steps.store: quant/data/sec/raw + facts (gitignored, R2); committed canonical/* (golden five), inspector*, coverage, pit_gates

pipelines.tagPriorityAcrossFilings: NO (normalize.py key includes accession; restatements.py resolves by availability)

steps.view: AS_OF_LATEST at build date: ONE latest vintage per cell; row.filed = latest re-reporting filing (often a later comparative)
steps.store: quant/data/sec/consumer/CIK*.json (5073, committed), schema vu-consumer-fundamentals-1.0.0, annual 13y, quarterly 8q, TTM

steps.view: bitemporal revisions (availableAt, revisionId, restatementStatus); golden five only (AAPL, JPM, MSFT, NVDA, XOM); no EPS in METRIC_MAP

steps.logic: delegates to P1 (export_inspector_view, PeriodResolver); policy guards UNSAFE_BACKTEST_POLICY; no runtime caller found in repo

steps.input: bulk companyfacts.zip; CIK via company-names / SEC name lookup
steps.tagSelection: EPS: ONE tag per company (first in priority with >=4 quarters) incl. EarningsPerShareBasic as fallback (basic/diluted mixing); revenue: per-period tag priority (first tag with any filing for the period wins)
steps.period: quarter 80-100d, FY 350-380d, Q4 = FY - 3 quarters with filed = FY filing only
steps.pit: earliest filed per tag and period, ANY form (no periodic filter)

steps.tagSelection: seriesWithFallback: first tag in priority with any filing for the period wins (EPS, revenue, GP, cost, OI, NI); EPS fallback includes EarningsPerShareBasic
steps.period: quarterlyFirst, Q4 = FY - 3 with filed = max(components)
steps.pit: earliest filing per tag (original before /A), periodic forms

tagLists: P7 sec-pit.mjs EPS_TAGS/REV_TAGS (different order: Revenues first)
consumerDerivations: discover/engines/fundamentals.js + unternehmen.js (growth, margins, own TTM growth)
